Shoulders respond to volume spread across the week, so aim to hit them two or three times rather than one big session. Most of the growth comes from the side delts, so lateral raises (dumbbell, cable, or machine) deserve real sets, usually in the 10 to 20 rep range, taken close to failure. Keep a heavy press in the mix too, either overhead or incline, since it builds the front delts and loads the whole shoulder girdle.

Your rear delts get left behind more often than any other part, so add face pulls or reverse flyes. Add weight or reps over the weeks, because that progression is what drives the growth.

If you want, I can build you a program with a shoulder focus or a single shoulder day, and the app will set the numbers.
